text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower has managed to leave
quite a
mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Nishino Flower and I visit the

racecourse to enjoy the special open day
event
being held.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The food was delicious, wasn't it? There
was such
a huge variety of dishes on
offer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I normally just eat bentos,
but it's nice to
eat out
once in a while! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to thank me! I love
making those
lunches!
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for always makin...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I never knew the winds here could be
like this.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange.
This is the same turf I run on with
everything I have, but now I'm
just strolling
casually along it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's the same place, the
atmosphere
is completely different.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And I've never really thought about it
before, but
the turf here is always so
lush.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
This racecourse made me who I am
today. It's like
my second home! I love it
here!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But I'm going to keep growing even
bigger. Why,
I'm sure I'll be taller than
you someday, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, right? ♪
You know, I've realized
something.
choice_data_list: That's something to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My small stature and inexperience are
just proof
that I've got a lot of changing
to do in the future.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So... Please watch over me as I transform
into the
Umamusume I hope to
become! ♪
